item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02505","case1_error":"Treats 70% cheaper as paying 70% of the original price instead of 30%.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 107 after correctly writing 180 − (41 × 2), which yields 98.","reason":"Case 1 uses an erroneous discount relation; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number after a correct formula.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02506","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 88 after correctly writing (16 × 8) − 30, which yields 98.","case2_error":"Incorrectly states Lyft costs $4 more than Uber; it costs $3 less.","reason":"Case 1 has a correct formula followed by an unsupported number; case 2 misrepresents the given price relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02507","case1_error":"Omits the 20% primer discount, charging full price and obtaining $275 instead of $245.","case2_error":"Invents 21 cats for Ben by also assigning him Dave's stated cat relationship.","reason":"Case 1 ignores a required discount; case 2 adds pets through an unsupported assignment of another person's relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02508","case1_error":"Answer marker says 300, but the explanation correctly computes $200 remaining; this is an answer conflict.","case2_error":"Reports net spending of $23 as money remaining, without subtracting it from the initial $74.","reason":"Case 1 contains only an answer-marker conflict with correct mathematics, so a shared mathematical error cannot be diagnosed.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02509","case1_error":"Subtracts six inches from rim height when the required reach is six inches above it.","case2_error":"Treats pay cut to 75% as a reduction by 75%, leaving 25% instead.","reason":"Case 1 reverses the direction of a height offset; case 2 confuses a retained percentage with a removed percentage.","judgment":"different"}]}
